description: This Java class `RetrievePolicyEntryStrategy` handles retrieving policy entries in a policy management system. It extends an abstract strategy class and overrides methods to process `RetrievePolicyEntry` commands, returning policy entry data or error results.

classes.name: RetrievePolicyEntryStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that handles the retrieval of a specific policy entry given a policy ID and label, producing a result containing the policy event or an error.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Handles the core logic to retrieve a policy entry based on the provided command, returning a result with the policy event or an error if not found.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Generates an optional EntityTag for the newPolicy entity corresponding to the command's label, used for optimistic concurrency control.
